The study of such phenomena is also known as cymatics.

Chladni is able to simulate the phenomena digitally.

## What is MIDI?

MIDI (Musical Instrument Digital Interface) is a standard protocol for electronic musical instruments, computers and other equipment to communicate and synchronize with each other.

A MIDI controller is an essential tool for every musician. With a midi controller, you can play virtual instruments, control recording software, and even manipulate effects.

## Why use a MIDI controller with our app?

You can use the app without a midi controller, but we recommend that you use it with one. MIDI controller allows you to experience real-time response from the application. Playing a real musical instrument will help you develop the right musical sense of rhythm more easily.

The app is suitable for both beginners and professional musicians.
